backup.keyCopiedDesc: Store it somewhere only you can access.

backupPrompt.landingTitle: Your first flight landed. Keep your airline.
backupPrompt.landingBody: It lives on a key saved only in this browser. Copy it or download it now, and a cleared browser or a new device can't take your airline away.
